Details of improvements in environmental and social impacts

In terms of energy, we are implementing a solar project for captive use to reduce Scope 1 emissions and setting up a briquettes plant for captive use to lower Scope 2 emissions. Additionally, we have upgraded our effluent and sewage treatment plants to enhance water efficiency. In waste management, we established a solvent recovery plant at our Tarapur unit to reduce waste generation and environmental pollution.
